items.title: Will AI cure cancer? Probably not, but it could change how we fight it
European capital markets require efforts to attract biotech listings
items.summary: Experts are looking at broader reforms and reorganization to revitalise biotech’s interest in European capital markets.

items.title: GSK’s $10.6bn Nuvalent bet pays off with second lung cancer drug approval
items.summary: GSK’s Nelkarmi will now be in direct competition with Roche’s established ALK inhibitor Alecensa.

items.title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5bn to advance drug pipeline
items.summary: Isomorphic Labs has raised $5bn in a Series C financing round to support the development of its AI platform and advance its therapeutic candidates towards clinical evaluation.

items.title: Revolution Medicines’ Rasonque gains EC authorisation for pancreatic cancer
items.summary: The EC has granted marketing authorisation for Revolution Medicines’ rasonque to treat adult patients with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma who have undergone at least one systemic therapy earlier.
